name: motion-ease-bounce-out
title: Bounce Out
description: Dừng lại bằng mấy cú nảy như vật rơi xuống sàn; cho rơi và tiếp đất.out).

moworks.author: moworks

options.graph: a canvas to draw the curve on (a teaching guide; none by default)

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Target moves 0 → 100 % on bounce.out, 800 ms: contacts at 36 / 73 / 91 % of the time, rebounds 25 / 6 / 1.6 % high. Rule: falls and landings. Squash on contact is a separate item (CustomBounce with Squash). Small demo: 1200 ms across 114 px beside the curve graph and a 12-frame spacing ruler (guides, not ported). Params: duration (0.8 s) · ease (bounce.out).
